title: antiaris toxicaria
intro: Antiaris toxicaria, commonly known as the upas tree, is a tropical plant species native to Southeast Asia. The upas tree has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which can help in treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Antiaris toxicaria include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and anti- spasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Antiaris toxicaria include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
